properties.title: DREF: Zimbabwe - Drought Anticipatory Actions
properties.summary: IFRC launched a DREF allocation for Zimbabwe (Drought) on 5 Nov 2026. CHF 150,000 requested, CHF 150,000 funded (100%), 9,000 people targeted. Active; IFRC lists the end date as 28 Feb 2027. Zimbabwe has had 2 IFRC appeals start in the last 90 days, against an average of 0.40 per 90 days over 2016-11-19 to 2026-08-20.
